summary: Integrality from α⁻¹ ∈ Ô; the frame identity is a geometric sum of the root of unity Φ_σ(ζ)/Φ_τ(ζ).

steps.claim: Integrality: α⁻¹·ζ^i ∈ Ô, because α⁻¹ ∈ Ô (`inv_α_mem`) and ζ^i is an algebraic integer.
The frame identity, for all infinite places σ, τ.
steps.lean:
fun σ τ ↦ by
  split <;> simp [*, starRingEnd_apply, ← map_star_complex, -inv_pow, ← mul_pow, ↓← mul_sum,
    ← sum_range, isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.ne_zero out]
  erw [geom_sum_eq fun h ↦ ‹¬_›
    (Function.LeftInverse.injective mk_Φ congr($((isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.powerBasis P.K).algHom_ext
    (eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one h)).1))]; simp [mul_pow, ← map_pow, isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.1]⟩

steps.claim: Split on σ = τ and simplify: the sum is k·∑_{i<N₁} (Φ_σ(ζ)·conj Φ_τ(ζ))^i. If σ = τ every term is |Φ_σ(ζ)|^{2i} = 1 and the sum is k·N₁; this case is closed.
steps.lean:
split <;> simp [*, starRingEnd_apply, ← map_star_complex, -inv_pow, ← mul_pow, ↓← mul_sum,
    ← sum_range, isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.ne_zero out]

steps.claim: If σ ≠ τ, put q = Φ_σ(ζ)·conj Φ_τ(ζ) = Φ_σ(ζ)/Φ_τ(ζ). Then q ≠ 1: otherwise Φ_σ and Φ_τ agree on ζ, hence on E = K(ζ) (power basis), hence σ = τ. So the geometric sum is (q^{N₁} − 1)/(q − 1) = 0, since ζ^{N₁} = 1.
steps.lean:
erw [geom_sum_eq fun h ↦ ‹¬_›
    (Function.LeftInverse.injective mk_Φ congr($((isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.powerBasis P.K).algHom_ext
    (eq_of_mul_inv_eq_one h)).1))]; simp [mul_pow, ← map_pow, isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.1]⟩
